name: Abbey Mortgage Bank Plc
source: Abbey Mortgage Bank Plc audited financial statements for the year ended 31 December 2025 (NGX corporate disclosure, quarter 5 filing, March 2026). Statement of financial position, printed page 33, and the five-year financial summary, printed page 91. Both sources print the same figures. CRON 20261118: cash and cash equivalents added from the audited statement of cash flows (printed page 37, note 35.1): 33,639,436 for 2025 and 3,012,215 for 2024 in thousands of Naira. The statement of financial position prints cash on hand 29,823, cash balances with the Central Bank 1,020,000 and due from other banks 43,696,918 for 2025; the cash flow closing balance is used because it is the cash and cash equivalents measure and excludes placements not callable within three months.
